title: Validation report for cdif.bbr.metadata.provProperties.provActivity - PROV-O Provenance Activity

entries.message: Test was expected to fail and it did.

ValidationError: 42 is not of type 'array'

Failed validating 'type' in schema['allOf'][0]['properties']['prov:used']:
    {'type': 'array',
     'description': 'Entities the activity used. Per PROV-O each value '
                    'denotes a prov:Entity. An item may be (1) a string '
                    'URI or free-text reference, (2) an {@id} reference, '
                    '(3) an inline entity object carrying an @type that '
                    'includes prov:Entity plus a schema.org type for the '
                    'kind of thing used, e.g. '
                    '["prov:Entity","schema:Thing"] (instrument), '
                    '["prov:Entity","schema:CreativeWork"] '
                    '(method/protocol), or '
                    '["prov:Entity","schema:SoftwareApplication"] '
                    '(software), or (4) a role-keyed wrapper naming what '
                    'was used through one of the recognized "used" '
                    'relations (schema:instrument, bios:computationalTool, '
                    'bios:reagent), or (5) a role-keyed wrapper under a '
                    'role a consuming profile defines for itself, admitted '
                    'by shape rather than by name. Base leaves the wrapped '
                    'value loose; profiles/extensions (e.g. '
                    'cdifProvActivity, adaProduct) pin its shape '
                    '(Instrument, ComputationalTool, Reagent, ...) and '
                    'close the set of role names they accept.',
     'items': {'anyOf': [{'type': 'string'},
                         {'description': 'a resolvable reference to a '
                                         'representation of the software '
                                         'or instrument used',
                          '$ref': 'https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/annotated/bbr/metadata/cdifDataType/objectReference/schema.yaml'},
                         {'type': 'object',
                          'description': 'an inline prov:Entity used by '
                                         'the activity (see prov:used '
                                         'description)',
                          'properties': {'@type': {'type': 'array',
                                                   'items': {'type': 'string'},
                                                   'minItems': 1,
                                                   'contains': {'const': 'prov:Entity'}}},
                          'required': ['@type']},
                         {'type': 'object',
                          'description': 'a role-keyed wrapper naming an '
                                         'instrument used by the activity; '
                                         'the extension layer pins the '
                                         'value to an Instrument '
                                         'description.',
                          'required': ['schema:instrument']},
                         {'type': 'object',
                          'description': 'a role-keyed wrapper naming a '
                                         'computational tool (software) '
                                         'used; the extension layer pins '
                                         'the value to a ComputationalTool '
                                         'description.',
                          'required': ['bios:computationalTool']},
                         {'type': 'object',
                          'description': 'a role-keyed wrapper naming a '
                                         'reagent / material used; the '
                                         'extension layer pins the value '
                                         'to a Reagent description.',
                          'required': ['bios:reagent']},
                         {'type': 'object',
                          'description': 'a role-keyed wrapper under a '
                                         'role name this layer does not '
                                         'recognize: an object carrying at '
                                         'least one prefixed-name (CURIE) '
                                         'property other than @id / @type, '
                                         'whose value is an {@id} '
                                         'reference, an inline '
                                         'description, or an array of '
                                         'either. CDIF deliberately does '
                                         'NOT enumerate profile-defined '
                                         'roles here: the three named '
                                         'above (schema:instrument, '
                                         'bios:computationalTool, '
                                         'bios:reagent) are in '
                                         'CDIF/bioschemas scope and stay '
                                         'explicit, while a domain profile '
                                         'is free to relate an activity to '
                                         'what it used through a role of '
                                         'its own without CDIF having to '
                                         'know the term. A consuming '
                                         'profile is expected to CLOSE the '
                                         'set to the roles it defines, so '
                                         'this branch is permissive BY '
                                         'DESIGN at the base layer and the '
                                         'restriction returns at the '
                                         'profile layer. allOf composes '
                                         'correctly in that direction -- '
                                         'base permissive, profile '
                                         'restrictive -- because an allOf '
                                         'intersection can only narrow: a '
                                         'role this layer admits by shape '
                                         'is still rejected by any profile '
                                         'that does not name it.',
                          'minProperties': 1,
                          'propertyNames': {'pattern': '^(@id|@type|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)$'},
                          'not': {'description': '@id / @type alone is the '
                                                 'plain {@id} reference '
                                                 'branch, not a wrapper; '
                                                 'at least one property '
                                                 'here must be a role.',
                                  'propertyNames': {'enum': ['@id',
                                                             '@type']}},
                          'patternProperties': {'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$': {'anyOf': [{'type': 'object',
                                                                                                                  'description': 'an '
                                                                                                                                 '{@id} '
                                                                                                                                 'reference '
                                                                                                                                 'to, '
                                                                                                                                 'or '
                                                                                                                                 'an '
                                                                                                                                 'inline '
                                                                                                                                 'description '
                                                                                                                                 'of, '
                                                                                                                                 'the '
                                                                                                                                 'entity '
                                                                                                                                 'used '
                                                                                                                                 'in '
                                                                                                                                 'this '
                                                                                                                                 'role'},
                                                                                                                 {'type': 'array',
                                                                                                                  'minItems': 1,
                                                                                                                  'items': {'type': 'object'}}]}}}]},
     'x-jsonld-id': 'http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#used'}

On instance['prov:used']:
